title: CameraConfig
description: The 'data' object of Data/Camera/*.json. Mirrors FLRCameraConfig (Source/LRCamera/Public/LRCameraTypes.h). Distances in centimeters, angles in degrees, speeds in km/h, times in seconds.

DefaultMode.description: Camera mode used when the camera manager starts.

ShoulderRoughness.description: Shake multiplier outside the lanes (shoulder, rumble strips).

RoughnessLagSeconds.description: Smoothing time of the roughness between lane and shoulder, seconds.

GlobalShakeScale.description: Accessibility multiplier of every procedural shake (0 = no shake).

InteriorNearClipCm.description: Near clip plane of the interior cameras, cm.

TeleportSnapDistanceCm.description: Car movement in one camera update treated as a teleport (snaps the smoothing), cm.

SpeedFovCurve.description: FLRSpeedFovCurve: FOV that widens with speed (monotonic).

MinFovDeg.description: Horizontal FOV at low speed, degrees.

MaxFovDeg.description: Horizontal FOV at full speed, degrees.

StartSpeedKmh.description: Speed where the widening starts, km/h.

FullSpeedKmh.description: Speed where MaxFovDeg is reached, km/h.

ReferenceSpeedKmh.description: Speed at which the amplitudes apply unscaled, km/h.

MaxScale.description: Upper clamp of the speed scale.

LookAhead.description: FLRLookAheadParams: yaw toward the target lane and into the curve.

LookAheadSeconds.description: Time horizon of the look-ahead point, seconds.

MinDistanceMeters.description: Minimum distance of the look-ahead point, meters.

MaxYawDeg.description: Maximum look-ahead yaw, degrees (0 disables it).

LagSeconds.description: Smoothing time of the yaw, seconds.

CurvatureScale.description: Weight of the road curvature term.

HeadModel.description: FLRHeadModelParams: spring-damper head driven by G forces.

NaturalFrequencyHz.description: Natural frequency of the neck spring, Hz.

LongitudinalCmPerG.description: Head travel per longitudinal G, cm.

LateralCmPerG.description: Head travel per lateral G, cm.

VerticalCmPerG.description: Head travel per vertical G, cm.

RollDegPerG.description: Head roll per lateral G, degrees.

PitchDegPerG.description: Head pitch per longitudinal G, degrees.

MaxOffsetCm.description: Clamp of the head offset per axis, cm.

MaxRollDeg.description: Clamp of the head roll, degrees.

MaxPitchDeg.description: Clamp of the head pitch, degrees.

Chase.description: FLRChaseCameraParams. Distance and height come from the vehicle definition.

DistanceScale.description: Multiplier of the vehicle's chase distance.

HeightScale.description: Multiplier of the vehicle's chase height.

YawLagSeconds.description: Smoothing time of the arm yaw, seconds.

HeightLagSeconds.description: Smoothing time of the pivot height, seconds.

DistanceLagSeconds.description: Smoothing time of the arm length, seconds.

AccelDistanceCmPerMs2.description: Arm stretch per m/s^2 of longitudinal acceleration, cm.

MaxAccelDistanceCm.description: Clamp of the acceleration stretch, cm.

SpeedDistanceCmPer100Kmh.description: Extra arm length per 100 km/h, cm.

LookAtAheadCm.description: Distance of the look-at point ahead of the car, cm.

MinGroundClearanceCm.description: Minimum camera height above the road surface, cm.

PitchOffsetDeg.description: Extra pitch of the mount, degrees.

MinFovDeg.description: Lowest FOV the setting accepts, degrees.

MaxFovDeg.description: Highest FOV the setting accepts, degrees.

SpeedFovExtraDeg.description: FOV added at high speed, degrees.

SpeedFovStartKmh.description: Speed where the extra FOV starts, km/h.

SpeedFovFullKmh.description: Speed where the full extra FOV is reached, km/h.

HorizonStabilization.description: Fraction of the body roll and pitch removed from the view.

ViralPostProcess.description: FLRViralPostProcessParams: FPostProcessSettings overrides. A negative value leaves the engine / volume setting untouched.

ViralPreset.description: FLRViralPresetParams: one preset of the Viral camera.

DisplayName.description: Name shown in menus and the HUD.

MountAnchor.description: Vehicle anchor the mount starts from.

MountOffsetCm.description: Offset from the anchor in actor space, cm.

MountPitchDeg.description: Extra pitch of the mount, degrees.

bInterior.description: The camera is inside the cabin (cabin audio mix).

HorizonStabilization.description: Fraction of the body roll and pitch removed from the view.

DefaultPreset.description: Preset active when the game starts.

bViralArtifactsEnabled.description: Accessibility: false disables every post-process artifact.
